title: Janus Soft Benefits
address: 43300 Southern Walk Plaza, Suite 619, Ashburn, VA 20148
intro: Prepared for candidates considering Janus Soft. This is the 2026–27 benefits program that sits with an offer: coverage, time away, retirement, pay, and the allowances beside salary. Every figure is the term in the company summary.

sections.title: Medical, dental, and vision
sections.lead: The company pays the full premium for the employee and shares the cost for family members.
points: Janus Soft pays 100% of the premium for the employee, and a generous contribution for other family members, for health, dental, and vision insurance.
Coverage is effective the first of the next month from the date of hire.

rows: 1st of the month after the date of hire
1st of the month after the date of hire

sections.title: Paid time off
sections.lead: Time away is part of the offer, not a balance you have to earn week by week.
points: Unlimited paid time off, subject to meeting the minimum work-hours requirement.

sections.title: Retirement
sections.lead: The 401(k) is a safe-harbor plan, and the match follows the employee’s own contribution.
points: Janus Soft offers a 401(k) plan through safe harbor.
The company matches 10% of the employee contribution.
The company pays dollar for dollar up to 10% of the employee contribution.

sections.title: Compensation
sections.lead: Pay is meant to compete, and extra recognition does not wait for a review cycle.
points: Highly competitive salary. Janus Soft Inc. pays its employees top dollars and pays one of the best salaries.
Annual and spot bonus. Spot bonuses are based on feedback from the employee’s supervisor.

sections.title: Employee referral
sections.lead: Introducing someone who is hired is paid as a real bonus, not a token.
points: Janus Soft pays a referral bonus of up to $10,000.00, spread over three months, for each successfully hired employee, for the life of that employment.

sections.title: Disability and life insurance
sections.lead: Income protection and life insurance are company-paid on the schedule below.
points: Janus Soft offers short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance.
The contribution schedule on file lists life insurance and short-term disability. Both are paid in full by the company.

rows: 1st of the month, 60 days after the date of hire
1st of the month, 60 days after the date of hire

sections.title: Training and tuition
sections.lead: Skill-building and tuition have a set yearly allowance.
points: Janus Soft reimburses up to $3,000.00 per year toward skills and tuition.

sections.title: Health and technology
sections.lead: A yearly allowance covers the tools and programs people actually use.
points: Janus Soft reimburses up to $1,000.00 per calendar year for health and technology products and programs, including laptops, gym memberships, cell phones, and tablets.
